limits: Fake Claude Code host; no model contacted. The scan matches exact 8-word windows after normalization: paraphrased held-out content is not detected. Windows shared with development prompts are not fingerprinted (held-out prompts keep 11 to 45 windows each). Sandbox denial is asserted only on macOS (sandbox-exec); elsewhere real optimizer calls are refused.
outcome: passed: The committed held-out fingerprints (sha256 of held-out case ids and of every 8-word normalized window of the held-out prompts not shared with a development prompt) are reproducible and bound to the FREEZE hash of held-out.json; the analyze skill body and every development prompt pass the scan; a held-out 8-word excerpt in different case and spacing, a held-out case id (by pattern and by hash), the held-out canary planted only in held-out rollout workspaces, and the rollout canary are refused (holdout-contamination); stale fingerprints are refused (holdout-fingerprint-stale); the channel checks before every call and a refused input never reaches the host. The sandboxed optimizer host runs Claude Code with no tools, no plugin and an empty working directory in a disposable profile without API keys; its protected paths include held-out.json, the SPEC-069 scoring and fixture sources and .git, and on macOS the isolation probe is enforced and a read of held-out.json under the sandbox fails; teardown is clean. Negative controls: an unverified credential source (route-unverified), a paid key in the parent environment (paid-route-refused), OpenCode as optimizer host (route-unverified) and a non-fake in-process transport (isolation-failed) are refused.
